Jatani

I'm afraid your questions are quite broad, so I cannot provide specific answers.  What I recommend is for you to study the materials we have available online as workshop materials.  They are free for you to use and listen to our lectures.  There are also many exercises that show you how to analyse data using the Distance software.

Work your way through the materials at

https://workshops.distancesampling.org/online-course/

and as you progress, you can ask questions either on that website, or back here on this list.  Good luck.
